patthana23.53:1.1: dhammaṃ paccayā anidassana appaṭigho micchattaniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.53:2.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na sammatta niyataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassana appaṭigho sammattaniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.53:3.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na aniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho aniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā ekavīsa. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na maggārammaṇaṃ
